**Severity:** warning · **Area:** Imports / helpers / route modules (`RV3xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
No route matches "{path}" (routes from {routesDir ?? "the router"}).
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Point the Link at an existing route path (check src/routes), or add the missing route file.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { Link } from "@rivetjs/router/client";
export const A = () => <Link to="/abuot">About</Link>;
```

```tsx prefer
import { Link } from "@rivetjs/router/client";
export const A = () => <Link to="/about">About</Link>;
```

## When it is reported

Language service only; warning; TS-side text (not Rust). Could suggest nearest route.
